title: Refuse to publish when lore-cli's version differs from quest's (Article 3.6)
description: Constitution Article 3 clause 6 (opum-ai/opum-agent 73ba142): each CLI release workflow refuses to publish when the two version numbers differ; the check, not the prose, keeps the pair together. lore-cli builds the mirror check; the mechanism is agreed with lore-cli directly (proposal sent 2026-09-27: compare own package.json version to the peer package.json on the peer main via the GitHub contents API, fail closed on any read error, dry runs included, no override flag).

acceptanceCriteria.text: scripts/publish-release.mjs refuses, dry run included, when lore-cli's version on the agreed ref differs from quest's package.json version, naming both versions and the refs read
release.yml runs the same check before any npm publish
Any failure to read the peer version refuses rather than passes, and tests cover match, mismatch and read failure
The mechanism matches what lore-cli built, confirmed with lore-cli

implementationNotes: Built to the mechanism proposed to lore-cli on 2026-09-27. No reply yet: lore-cli is blocked on its own user's version prompt, per opum-agent. scripts/qualification/version-parity.mjs reads @opum-ai/lore package.json on opum-ai/lore-cli main through the gh contents API, raw. It refuses on a mismatch, a read failure, malformed JSON, another package name or a missing version. publish-release.mjs runs it first, before the receipt, credential or any publish, in dry runs too. release.yml runs it with --require before its first npm publish. Evidence: test/qcli386-version-parity.test.ts, 8 tests. Mutation control: disabling the mismatch comparison turned exactly the mismatch test red. A live run refused as expected: quest 0.10.0, lore 0.9.3 on lore-cli main. bun run check exit 0, 753 tests. AC4 stays OPEN until lore-cli confirms its mirror reads quest-cli main the same way.
